pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chart-radar against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-chart-radar id="c" label="Навыки: Анна и Борис" x="skill" y="anna,boris" max="10" x-label="Навык" y-format="integer"></sf-chart-radar>
<sf-chart-radar id="g" label="Оценка товара" x="criterion" y="score" max="10" grid="circle" x-label="Критерий" y-format="integer" table="hidden"></sf-chart-radar>

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by the spokes' count and range, each series' strongest and weakest spoke and the two series compared; a spoke per measure, a filled ring per series, and the second series' marks of their own shape
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.x, settings.y, settings.max, settings.fill, settings.summary, settings.legend

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"anna": "Анна", "boris": "Борис"}; c.items = [{"skill": "Аналитика", "anna": 8, "boris": 5}, {"skill": "Код", "anna": 9, "boris": 6}, {"skill": "Дизайн", "anna": 4, "boris": 8}, {"skill": "Общение", "anna": 6, "boris": 9}, {"skill": "Тесты", "anna": 7, "boris": 4}, {"skill": "Планирование", "anna": 5, "boris": 7}]; document.querySelector('#g').items = [{"criterion": "Цена", "score": 7}, {"criterion": "Качество", "score": 9}, {"criterion": "Доставка", "score": 6}, {"criterion": "Сервис", "score": 8}, {"criterion": "Упаковка", "score": null}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#c figure'); const s = document.querySelector('#c svg[role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(s.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0|\u202f/gu, ' '); return f && document.getElementById(f.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Навыки: Анна и Борис' && s.getAttribute('aria-roledescription') === 'лепестковая диаграмма' && s.tabIndex === 0 && d === 'Осей: 6, значения от 4 до 9. Анна: сильнее всего — Код (9), слабее всего — Дизайн (4). Борис: сильнее всего — Общение (9), слабее всего — Тесты (4). Анна выше, чем Борис, на осях: 3 из 6, ниже: 3.' && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-radar-spoke').length === 6 && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-radar-area').length === 2 && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-radar-series[data-series=anna] > circle').length === 6 && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-radar-series[data-series=boris] > path.sf-chart-radar-dot').length === 6 && [...document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-radar-tick')].pop().textContent === '10' && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-radar-legend-item').length === 2; })()

checks.title: the arrows go round the spokes and across the series, each move said with the spoke, the series and the value; End goes to the last spoke; Enter chooses a value; Escape clears
checks.covers: keyboard.host (ArrowRight, ArrowDown, End, Enter, Escape), events.select
